description:
The process starts with defining the objectives of a marketing campaign, including the target audience and goals such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.
The marketing team creates the content, designs the visuals, and selects channels for promotion, whether digital ads, emails, or social media posts.
The campaign is launched, and its performance is tracked in real-time through various metrics like click-through rates and conversions.
Leads generated from the campaign are collected in the CRM system, where sales teams can follow up.
The process concludes when the campaign period ends, and performance is analyzed for future optimization.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Start campaign planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Objectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Objectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Objectives_Content</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Objectives_Content</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Content_Visuals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Content_Visuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visuals_Channels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visuals_Channels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channels_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channels_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Split" name="Run campaign activities in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Tracking</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Leads</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PeriodEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Tracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tracking_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Leads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_FollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalesFollowUp" name="Follow up with leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_FollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUp_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnd" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PeriodEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PeriodEnd_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnd"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Join" name="Campaign activities complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tracking_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUp_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PeriodEnd_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Analysis</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Analysis</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analysis_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign analysis complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analysis_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Objectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Objectives_Content" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Content_Visuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visuals_Channels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channels_Launch" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_Split" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Tracking" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Split" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Leads" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Split" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Split" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tracking_Join" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_SalesFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_Join" sourceRef="Task_SalesFollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_Join" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnd" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Analysis" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivities_Join" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analysis_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Campaign"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
